pages.text: JEI or EMI adds terminal R/U lookup, ingredient recognition, synchronized search, missing-material hints, recipe transfer and an Immortal Furnace category. Without them, this book and the built-in guide remain sufficient.

AE2/RS exchange media bind immutable player UUIDs and show the latest username. A network mounts only one disk for each owner. ImmortalStorage includes its shared resource keys and needs no AEKey intermediary addon.

Immortal Power conversion is configurable in the mod screen and immortalstorage-common.toml. FE, Botania Mana and Ars Source groups appear only when their target mod is installed; each has an enable switch, ratio and tick cap.
